pages.title: Accumulate
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords, Axes, Tridents$(br2)§lEffect: §r Hold right-click to charge; a full charge makes your next attack deal multiplied damage with knockback. Taking damage or switching weapons interrupts the charge.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other melee damage/growth enchantments.
